subject: skill/stack/playwright
claim: Write Playwright Python end-to-end tests through the Pytest plugin: install pytest-playwright plus the browsers (playwright install), name files and functions with the test_ prefix, and request the built-in page fixture; tests run headless on Chromium by default. Drive assertions with auto-waiting locators and web-first expects (page.get_by_role(...), expect(page).to_have_title(...)) instead of fixed sleeps. Capture visual evidence with page.screenshot(path=..., full_page=True) or a single element via page.locator(sel).screenshot(...), and use buffer capture when feeding a pixel diff.
notes: Installation backs the pytest-playwright plugin, the test_ prefix convention, the page fixture, the headless/Chromium default, and web-first assertions with get_by_role. Screenshots backs path/full_page, element screenshots and buffer capture. Both agree; uncertainty is modest because the corpus has no page on explicit wait strategies — the claim stays inside what was fetched (auto-waiting locators/expect).
